For permutations unique basic I will mark used and skip duplicates.

```python
def permute_unique(nums):
    nums.sort(); out = []
    used = [False] * len(nums)
    def rec(cur):
        if len(cur) == len(nums):
            out.append(cur[:]); return
        for i in range(len(nums)):
            if used[i]: continue
            if i > 0 and nums[i] == nums[i-1] and not used[i-1]: continue
            used[i] = True
            cur.append(nums[i])
            rec(cur)
            cur.pop()
            used[i] = False
    rec([])
    return out
```
